# UNH — Catalysts

## TL;DR

All near-term catalysts have fired. Q1 2026 earnings (April 21) beat by 10.2% and are fully priced into the +41.6% move. The CMS Medicare Advantage rate hike is a structural tailwind, not a price catalyst. No actionable catalyst exists within the next 10 trading days. The analyst average price target ($377.83) is now only 2.0% above the current price ($370.48), meaning upgrades are nearly exhausted as a price driver. The next scheduled binary is Q2 2026 earnings (~July 10–28). Live risk: RICO insulin-pricing lawsuit filed by the City of New Haven — still unpriced. (Source: web_research/UNH.json; swing_catalyst_news signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260501_194523.)

## Upcoming events

| Event | Date | Expected impact |
|---|---|---|
| Q2 2026 earnings | ~July 10–28, 2026 | Next binary — consensus Q2 EPS ~$4.84; guidance cadence is the market's focus; estimate sources diverge on exact date (July 10 vs July 28) |
| RICO insulin pricing lawsuit | Unscheduled | City of New Haven suit against UNH, Cigna, CVS Health — new legal risk layer, not yet priced |
| US midterm elections 2026 | Ongoing cycle | Healthcare policy likely a campaign topic — managed-care regulatory exposure |
| Middle East ceasefire talks | Active as of May 1 | Oil retreat May 1 reduces UNH's indirect cost-of-care exposure; Iran re-escalation is a macro tail |

## Recent news synthesis

**Q1 2026 earnings beat (April 21, 2026) — fully priced.** Adj. EPS $7.23 beat $6.56 consensus by 10.2%; medical cost ratio improved to 84% from 85%; full-year 2026 adj. EPS guidance raised to $18.25+. Wall Street responded immediately: Argus upgraded to Buy, TD Cowen, Piper Sandler, Truist, BofA, Morgan Stanley (Top Pick), and HSBC all raised price targets. TipRanks consensus: 18 Buy, 5 Hold, 0 Sell. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260501_194523.)

**Analyst consensus target now nearly at current price.** Average price target $377.83 (high $440, low $255). Current price $370.48 is just 2.0% below the average PT — the upgrade cycle is near-exhausted as a near-term price catalyst. Prior run (Apr 30) had avg PT $394.91 from 25 analysts; the May 1 figure ($377.83, TipRanks) reflects a different analyst sample. Both figures confirm the stock has approached or exceeded many prior targets. (Source: analyst_consensus, web_research/UNH.json, run 20260501_194523.)

**Regulatory and valuation pressures flagged.** News from May 2026 (Yahoo Finance) notes emerging regulatory and valuation risks as UNH approaches analyst price targets following April's 37% surge. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260501_194523.)

**RICO lawsuit — unpriced legal overhang.** New Haven filed RICO allegations against UNH, Cigna, and CVS Health for an alleged insulin pricing scheme. No timeline or quantified liability yet. (Source: web_research/UNH.json, run 20260501_194523.)

## Insider activity

No insider activity recorded in the current run. The prior 122-buy vs 29-sell signal (April 11 run) predated the earnings catalyst and is absorbed into current price. (Source: sentiment_analyst_agent signal, signals_combined.json, run 20260501_194523.)
